scope: Parità Quick rispetto ai sorgenti Widgets: inventario statico, non collaudo
completion_rule: fatto solo con test comportamentale eseguito e confronto visivo rivisto; differenze volute separate
routing: Fasi ricavate da phases.py per i comandi; destinazioni di superfici e richieste inferite e da affinare

items.title: NameDialog
items.description:
A little window around the picker: the prompt, the picker, OK and Cancel. `ask` runs it and answers (the
name, whether OK was pressed, the favourites as they stand): the favourites are the user's, so the caller keeps
them also when the window was cancelled.

items.title: CanopyLayoutDialog
items.description:
«On a canopy» (R281, study 22, decision 9): the canopy and four values; the general layout does the rest,
flush with the canopy's plane, a sub-field on each slope.

items.title: ManualView
items.description:
The manual (docs/manuale) inside the program: the chapters on the left, the chapter on the right, opened at
a heading's anchor; the links between chapters followed here, those to the web in the browser.

items.title: IfcImportDialog
items.description:
What was found and where it goes: the place (the file's, the site moved there, the site's origin), the north
when the file says two things, a preview from above, what is taken, approximated and left out. `plan()` is the plan
of the choices made.

items.title: DatasheetSheet
items.description:
The datasheet of an inverter from the catalogue (R297, study 23): a little window that stays open while the
work goes on, with the record's fields the checks use, in the catalogue's words, and the address of the
maker's datasheet when the record has it.

items.title: StringingPopup
items.description:
«String automatically…» (R308, study 23, M3; Daniel's choice of 02/11/2026): a little window hung at the
edge of the right panel, not modal (the plan can still be clicked to change the modules), with the options
inside: on what (the whole plant, the modules selected on the plan, one inverter), replace the strings there
are or add for the modules in no string only, the path of the strings, the modules in series, the DC/AC ratio
wanted as a free field with the sentence that says what it does. No judgement on the ratio: the energy cut is
checked once the year is computed, as today.

items.title: VariantsChoice

items.title: SiteDialog
items.description:

type the coordinates.

items.title: TemplateDialog
items.description: The template chosen, with its measures; outline() is the footprint from (0, 0), turn() its turn.

items.title: Appearance
items.description: The page; `settled` (theme, colour, backgrounds) when the choice has stopped changing for a moment.

items.title: Assistant
items.description:
The floating character; `area` is where he may stand (the main window: over every card, Daniel 24/10/2026),
between `top` and `bottom` pixels; `home` the card he starts on (the views), in the area's pixels.

items.title: SetupPages
items.description: Only the current step contributes to the card's height.

items.title: FilePage
items.description: The page, a card over the window's panels (the window places it, `place`).

items.title: PlantInspector
items.description:
The Inverter section of the Plant's right panel (design C10; R119; study 23): at the top the string chosen,
only while one is (R298); the inverters one by one with their menus (R297); the Strings of the inverter shown,
as cards or as a diagram (R298), with the commands at their head; the conditions of the checks; the sub-field
selected, for the proposal. The page never computes: it shows energy/plant.Plant and reports the designer's
edits as signals.

items.title: PlantPage
items.description: Phase 2: the strip (the inverters, the strings or the one chosen, the legend) and the place of the plan.

items.title: FittedPages
items.description:
The pages of the Settings as tall as the one shown, not as the tallest (a stack asks them all, each of them for
its height at a width too): every page stands alike in the section of File, and that section scrolls (R346).

items.title: MeridioPage
items.description:
Where Meridio thinks (task 14): the local model (the default) or Claude, the local models of this PC found
with the one to use and the steps when there is none (R105, ui/assistant_local.py), the local server and its
kind, the Claude model, the key in the system's keyring (set or removed here at once, never in the settings),
the consent given, the spoken voice. `survey` looks for the local models (assistant/local.survey, a stand-in in
the tests).

items.title: NavigationPage
items.description: The mouse in the views (study 15, 2.6): FreeCAD's styles, AutoCAD and SketchUp; the orbit; its centre.

items.title: Preferences
items.description:
The settings inside File. Every edit is applied by the window at once; the last edits can be undone and each
section can restore its defaults with a confirmation drawn here, never in a modal dialog.

items.title: PrivacyPage
items.description:
What leaves the PC, said in words, each service with its switch (study 18, G 6.2: three services were
called without a line anywhere).

items.title: ReportPage
items.description:
Who signs the reports (R61, reports.py): profiles with the name and title, the register, the firm, the
contacts and the logo, written here once and chosen for each project; the one for the projects that choose
none. Nothing of them is in the program: they stay in the settings of this PC.

items.title: Properties
items.description:
A page per kind and shape of object. A new result, an edit or another object of the same shape sets only
the values: the page is built again when the fields themselves change (a roof type with a slope or without,
a pitch from the sun or given). Building it again cost time and took away the field being written, with what
was in it (study 12, I1, I4, P5).

items.title: Properties.show_subfield
items.description:
`state` is where its layout stands (model.Project.layout_state): a layout to do again or failed
is said above the figures, as FreeCAD marks the objects to recompute and those in error.

items.title: ReportPage
items.description:
Phase 6: the title and what the preview is doing, the pages. The commands are in the phase's bar (phases.py) and
in the menu, and only there: a row of the same four here was the first thing on the page (R322, A2).
